svg.title: Observation, encoding and learning
svg.desc: Review reconstruction. Polysemantic responses are an observation; superposition is an encoding hypothesis involving more features than dimensions; recursive generalization is a proposed learning path through local similarities. A shared V-shape interpretation of one cat-and-car neuron does not refute superposition in general. Feature vectors are schematic, not measured.
